content.text: {"stops":[{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Snack your way down the market lanes, one skewer at a time."},{"poi_id":"p10","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Walk the nightingale floors and let the castle do the talking."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The gold leaf does all the talking; just stand there and let it."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Old wooden facades and the occasional maiko slipping past, if you’re lucky."},{"poi_id":"p15","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Tofu done so well you’ll forget it isn’t trying to be meat."},{"poi_id":"p13","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m3","note":"Lanterns, narrow lanes, and the hum of a city that knows how to stay up late."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Go early, before the selfie sticks wake up, and let the bamboo do the talking."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The garden is the real sermon here; the pond listens better than most visitors."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A quiet, considered lunch that happens to be entirely plant-based."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p9","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"Silver Pavilion, where the garden does most of the talking."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A canal path made for slow feet and cherry-blossom thoughts."},{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"The wooden stage hangs over the hillside like a dare."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"A thousand carved hands, all patient, all watching."}]}
Gion ease, eastern temple paths, Arashiyama green, then market farewell — every must-do tucked in, shoes off, eyes up.
